basicZh: 这其实挺好笑的，别太当真/半开玩笑的
basicEn: It's sort of funny, not too serious.
nativeEn: It's sort of tongue in cheek.
contextA: Are you serious about that dramatic post online?
contextAZh: 你在网上发的那个夸张评论是认真的吗？
contextB: Don't take it too literally; it's sort of tongue in cheek.
contextBZh: 别太字面理解，那其实只是半开玩笑的调侃而已。
tip: 💡 tongue in cheek：字面指“舌头抵住腮帮子”，指言论半开玩笑、并非一本正经。

basicZh: 别说出来，不然事情可能要搞砸了/别乌鸦嘴
basicEn: Don't say it, or it might go wrong.
contextA: Everything is running so smoothly today! We'll wrap up early.
contextAZh: 今天进展太顺了！看来咱们肯定能提前收工。
contextB: Shh, knock on wood! Let's not jinx anything before it's done.
contextBZh: 嘘，赶紧摸摸木头！在彻底搞定前，咱们可别乌鸦嘴坏了好运。
tip: 💡 jinx：专指“乌鸦嘴/带来霉运”，常与 knock on wood（祈求好运）连用。

basicZh: 我差不多接受/想通了这个事实
basicEn: I kind of accepted the fact that...
nativeEn: I've made peace with the fact that...
contextA: Are you still upset about missing out on the event?
contextAZh: 错过了那个活动，你心里还在难受吗？
contextB: Not really. I've made peace with the fact that I can't attend everything.
contextBZh: 不难受了。我已经彻底释怀，接受了‘不可能样样都赶上’这个事实。
tip: 💡 make peace with：与……握手言和/释怀，比 accepted 更有内心放下纠结的平静感。

basicZh: 展现我自己不同的侧面/展示多维度的我
contextA: Why do you share such a wide variety of hobbies online?
contextAZh: 你为什么在网上分享那么多跨度极大的兴趣爱好？
contextB: I want to create content that can truly showcase aspects of my personality.
contextBZh: 我想创作一些能真正展现我多面个性特质的内容。
tip: 💡 showcase：生动展示；aspects of personality 比 different sides 更地道饱满。

basicZh: 大家能看到私底下/幕后发生的事情
basicEn: People could see what happens secretly.
nativeEn: A huge peek behind the curtain.
contextA: What did you think of that documentary about studio production?
contextAZh: 你觉得那部关于电影幕后制作的纪录片怎么样？
contextB: It was fascinating! It offered a huge peek behind the curtain of the industry.
contextBZh: 太精彩了！它掀开帷幕，让观众得以一窥这个行业的幕后运转。
tip: 💡 a peek behind the curtain：源自戏剧幕布隐喻，指“窥探内部秘密/探秘幕后”。

basicZh: 在这情况下确实感觉很有道理/很真实
basicEn: It really feels true in this situation.
contextA: The mentor said consistency beats intensity in the long run.
contextAZh: 导师说从长远来看，持之以恒远胜过一时的突击冲刺。
contextB: Looking at our project results, that really rings true here.
contextBZh: 看看咱们的项目结果，这句话放在这里确实再真切不过了。
tip: 💡 ring true：意为“听起来真实可信/切中要害/引发共鸣”，比平淡生硬的 'feels true in this situation' 更地道自然。

basicZh: 你没必要按常规套路/老一套的方法来做事
basicEn: You don't have to do things the normal way.
nativeEn: You don't need to follow the beaten path.
contextA: Should I pursue the standard corporate ladder like everyone else?
contextAZh: 我应该像其他人一样按部就班地走传统的晋升路线吗？
contextB: Not necessarily. You don't need to follow the beaten path to build a fulfilling career.
contextBZh: 未必。想打造有成就感的事业，你完全没必要走别人踩出来的老路。
tip: 💡 the beaten path：指“老路/常规套路/现成路径”，常用搭配如 'follow/off the beaten path'，比 'do things the normal way' 形象生动得多。

basicZh: 有时候我没参加也不觉得有什么遗憾或难受
basicEn: Sometimes I don't feel bad about not joining.
nativeEn: I don't really feel like I'm missing out.
contextA: Aren't you going to the big weekend networking mixer?
contextAZh: 周末那场大型社交酒会你不去参加吗？
contextB: I'd rather rest at home; I don't really feel like I'm missing out.
contextBZh: 我宁愿在家里休息；我真不觉得没去会有什么错过的遗憾（拒绝FOMO）。
tip: 💡 miss out (FOMO)：'feel like I'm missing out' 直击“错失恐惧”，比 'don't feel bad about not joining' 地道精准得多。

basicZh: 他们的理念/想法和我想的是不是一回事？
basicEn: Do they believe in the same things as I do?
nativeEn: Are these values aligning with mine?
contextA: What is your main criteria when choosing a long-term business partner?
contextAZh: 你在挑选长期商业合作伙伴时最看重什么？
contextB: I always ask myself: Are these values aligning with mine?
contextBZh: 我总是会问自己：他们的核心价值观是否与我的同频契合？
tip: 💡 align with：意为“同频对齐/契合一致”，搭配 values 比平白的 'believe in the same things' 更显高级且具成熟格局。

basicEn: I'm part of this whole process.
nativeEn: I really am involved from the start to the finish.
contextA: Did you only help with the initial brainstorming stage?
contextAZh: 你只是在最初的头脑风暴阶段帮了下忙吗？
contextB: Not at all. From system design to production rollout, I really am involved from the start to the finish.
contextBZh: 完全不是。从系统架构设计到最终生产环境上线，我自始至终深度参与了全过程。
tip: 💡 from the start to the finish：指“自始至终/全流程闭环”，比普通的 'part of this whole process' 更具执行力与深度负责的闭环感。
